title: GH Real Estate Zoho Contracts to Zoho Sign Text Tag Registry
scope: Text tags embedded in Zoho Contracts content and converted to signer fields by Zoho Sign

official_sources.title: Add document fields using text tags

recipient_role_policy.manifest_rule: Every document or clause containing a tag must declare the intended recipient roles, and every signer role in that manifest must have at least one assigned field.

document_safety_policy.official_limit: Zoho documents the feature for documents less than 75 pages.
document_safety_policy.rule: Keep each tag on one physical line with ASCII {{ }}, straight double quotes, and no hidden line breaks. This registry intentionally forbids width-padding spaces so source scans remain deterministic.

mandatory_marker_policy.rule: Zoho documents the asterisk as the mandatory marker for text fields and checkboxes. It is not a Sign Date modifier, so GHRE forbids it on SD; Sign Date is populated automatically after signing. Existing simple signature and initial tags with a redundant asterisk are accepted for compatibility but the asterisk does not change their required behavior.

canonical_sign_date_policy.recipient_rule: Encode exactly one explicit R1-R25 recipient role per Sign Date tag and repeat the canonical tag separately for every recipient who needs a signing timestamp.
canonical_sign_date_policy.mandatory_marker_rule: Do not add *. Sign Date is system-populated after that recipient signs; Zoho documents the mandatory marker only for text fields and checkboxes.
canonical_sign_date_policy.verification_rule: The exact R1 syntax passed user-confirmed Zoho Contracts-to-Zoho Sign preview conversion on 2026-07-17. Complete one post-signature value check before publishing a live template.

evidence_policy.officially_documented_grammar: Syntax recorded from Zoho's current automatic-field-addition help page.
evidence_policy.rule: Official grammar, observed Contracts-to-Sign behavior, and tenant smoke-test evidence are separate facts. A documented tag is not automatically approved for this integration path.

compatibility_aliases.notes: Accepted for existing Contracts content. The asterisk is redundant for Initial and is not the canonical published syntax.

production_safe_simple_tags.behavior: Captures the recipient's initials. The user-confirmed {{I:R1*}} form is recorded separately as a compatibility alias.

GHRE canonical signing timestamp. Zoho Sign fills this field only after R1 signs and renders a zero-padded MM/DD/YYYY date, two-digit 12-hour time, AM/PM, and timezone. Use one separate tag per recipient and do not add *.
Collects a date entered by the recipient.
Collects recipient-entered text; append * when the text field must be mandatory.

Exact published shorthand for one checkbox. Approved only when an explicit recipient manifest contains R1 as the sole signer; configure mandatory behavior in the Sign editor unless a separate tenant smoke test proves tagged mandatory syntax.
Allows the recipient to attach a supporting document.
Adds a stamp field for the recipient.

official_but_contracts_pipeline_unverifi.notes: Choice field syntax is documented by Zoho Sign but is not approved for the Contracts pipeline.
Each option uses its own tag and options in one group must be on the same page.
Each checkbox in the group uses a separate tag with the same group name.

official_but_ghre_blocked_features.notes: GHRE uses explicit shorthand recipient roles for deterministic multi-recipient templates.
Zoho defaults an omitted recipient to the first recipient; GHRE requires an explicit recipient-role manifest and role-bearing tags except the exact single-recipient checkbox shorthand.

official_examples: {{<field type>:Recipient<n>:<field name in case of text field>*}}
official_but_ghre_blocked_features.notes: Named-field grammar is broader than the production allowlist and is not accepted by the scanner.

official_examples: {{<field type>:recipient<n>:<field name in case of text field>*(font="<Font Name>":fontsize="<font_size>":fontcolor="<color_code>")}}
official_but_ghre_blocked_features.notes: The official generic form uses colon separators while its example uses semicolons. Because the published separators are internally inconsistent, GHRE does not guess and requires an isolated tenant smoke test.
Zoho documents trailing spaces to increase field width. GHRE forbids them so source scans and diffs remain deterministic; adjust placement in a governed Sign template instead.
